subtitle: Lesson 20 · A panel pushes back on this exact build

code:
Q: "Why not integrate with Prairie View in real
    time instead of a 15-minute scheduled pull?"

A: No webhook or event capability exists -- a
   real-time call was never available. An inline
   call would put every ticket submission behind
   a legacy system's uptime. The scheduled pull
   decouples the two, accepting a known staleness
   window instead.
caption: The constraint rules the option out before cost ever enters it.

eyebrow: Challenge two · one flow vs. three
code:
Q: "Isn't three flows safer if each hospital's
    needs diverge later?"

A: Three maintained copies drift silently out of
   sync with each other. One domain-aware flow is
   the only version that proves a Lakeshore
   request lands with a Lakeshore group EVERY
   time -- not most of the time, across copies.
caption: Flexibility that drifts isn't actually flexible.
